payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear understanding of the problem of session segmentation in conversation systems, highlighting its importance and the proposed solutions.

claims.text: The problem of session segmentation involves retaining relevant context utterances while eliminating irrelevant ones in conversation systems.
Traditional document segmentation methods are not suitable for dialogue segmentation due to the unique characteristics of conversations.
An embedding-enhanced TextTiling approach is proposed to improve session segmentation by capturing semantics more effectively in noisy conversation data.
Session segmentation can significantly enhance the performance of retrieval-based conversation systems by providing better context management.
